Visual inspection confirms this: the paw lacks distinct toes and appears fused into the ground/pavement, a classic AI generation artifact. The Router also noted texture anomalies (severity 2) and perspective distortion in hind legs (severity 3). The animal_pose_auditor reported MINIMAL risk with high confidence keypoints, which contradicts the visual evidence of the paw fusion. As per instructions, I prioritize direct visual observation (Router) over the pose auditor's confidence scores when clear visual artifacts exist. The pose auditor likely missed the fine-grained fusion at the paw-ground interface because it focuses on joint centers. The topology boundary auditor's mask shows a coherent shape but doesn't rule out internal structural failure or boundary blending. The perceptual quality auditor found no global distortions, which is consistent with local structural artifacts. Therefore, the severity 4 for the paw is justified. The hind leg angulation (severity 3) is also visually plausible as an artifact given the slight 'floating' look of the rear right leg.
